integrations.access_help: Lets Claude, Cursor or another agent read and create data in your CRM using a token. It is off by default.

integrations.help_claude_desktop: Paste this block into claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude Desktop. It needs Node.js (it uses mcp-remote). On Windows the file is in %APPDATA%\Claude\ and on macOS in ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/.
integrations.help_claude_desktop_http: Because the URL is http:// and not on this computer, --allow-http is added.
integrations.help_cursor: Paste this block into ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or .cursor/mcp.json in your project).
integrations.help_vscode: Paste this block into .vscode/mcp.json in your project.
integrations.help_other: Use the Streamable HTTP transport with this URL and this header.
integrations.token_placeholder_note: You have not shown your token yet, so the block uses TOKEN. Copying replaces it with the real token.
integrations.tokens_help: Each agent can use its own token. You can revoke it at any time.
integrations.tokens_empty_description: Create a token to connect an agent.
integrations.scope_write_help: Create and edit data. It never deletes.
